legislation.notes: SB 540 signed by Gov. Kelly Ayotte on July 2, 2026 (8th state to sign; part of a 74-bill signing). Allows one plug-in solar generation system per metered customer with a maximum inverter output of 1,200W AC, certified by a nationally recognized testing laboratory, with no utility approval, interconnection review/agreement, or fees. Main provisions take effect January 1, 2027 (final text, section 7); the building-code section takes effect when a nationally recognized standard for plug-in systems is certified. Correction 2026-07-08: earlier note estimated effective ~July 27, 2026 from secondary sources — the adopted text sets January 1, 2027.
